findings.title: Request input reaches shell command
findings.detail: Snap score 0.99 (candidate, not proof). Command injection gives attackers code execution on the host.
findings.fix_hint: Pass an argument list with shell disabled and validate inputs.

findings.title: Non-atomic file overwrite
findings.detail: Snap score 0.99 (candidate, not proof). A crash mid-write leaves a truncated or empty file that breaks the next start.

evidence.snippet:
import json

def save_state(path, state):
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(state, f)

findings.fix_hint: Write to a temp file, fsync, then os.replace onto the target.

findings.title: Client-supplied user id used as identity
findings.detail: Snap score 0.99 (candidate, not proof). Callers can impersonate other users or escalate roles by editing the request.
findings.fix_hint: Derive identity only from the verified session or token.

findings.title: Secret value written to logs
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Logs are widely readable and retained, so leaked secrets spread and persist.
findings.fix_hint: Remove or mask the secret before logging.

findings.title: Weak randomness for tokens
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Predictable tokens can be guessed or reproduced by attackers.
findings.fix_hint: Use the platform cryptographic random generator.

findings.title: Mutable default arguments
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). State leaks between calls.
findings.fix_hint: Default to None and create inside.

findings.title: [absence] Missing input validation at boundary
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Bad input reaches deep code and causes crashes or injection.
findings.fix_hint: Validate with a schema at the entry point.

findings.title: Money stored as floating point
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Float rounding errors accumulate into wrong totals.
findings.fix_hint: Use integer minor units or Decimal.

findings.title: JWT signature or expiry not verified
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Attackers can forge tokens and impersonate any user.

evidence.snippet:
import jwt

def user_from_token(token):
    claims = jwt.decode(token, options={'verify_signature': False})
    return claims['sub']

findings.fix_hint: Verify signature, expiry, issuer and audience with a pinned algorithm.

findings.title: Check-then-act race
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Concurrent actors can interleave between check and act, causing duplicates or crashes.
findings.fix_hint: Use an atomic operation, unique constraint, or lock around check and act.

findings.title: [absence] IDOR: client id trusted for lookup
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Any user can read or edit other users' records by changing an id.
findings.fix_hint: Scope queries by the authenticated user id or verify ownership before use.

findings.title: User input rendered as template source
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Server-side template injection can lead to code execution.

evidence.snippet: from flask import Flask, request, render_template_string

findings.fix_hint: Keep templates static and pass user text as variables.

findings.title: Shared mutable state without lock
findings.detail: Snap score 0.96 (candidate, not proof). Unsynchronized updates lose writes and corrupt counters or caches.
findings.fix_hint: Guard shared state with a lock or use a thread-safe structure.

findings.title: [absence] Non-idempotent retryable operation
findings.detail: Snap score 0.95 (candidate, not proof). Retries create duplicate charges, rows or emails.
findings.fix_hint: Record a unique request ID and skip work already done.

findings.title: Password stored with weak hashing
findings.detail: Snap score 0.94 (candidate, not proof). Leaked hashes are cracked quickly.

evidence.snippet: log.info('login attempt user=%s password=%s api_key=%s', user, password, api_key)

findings.fix_hint: Switch to argon2 or bcrypt and rehash on login.

findings.title: Unescaped user content in HTML
findings.detail: Snap score 0.94 (candidate, not proof). Stored or reflected XSS lets attackers act as the victim.
findings.fix_hint: Escape by default and sanitise any intentional HTML.

findings.title: Batch failures dropped silently
findings.detail: Snap score 0.93 (candidate, not proof). Silent partial failure leaves data incomplete while dashboards show green.
findings.fix_hint: Collect failures, report them, and return a non-zero status when any occurred.

findings.title: [absence] Server-side request to user URL
findings.detail: Snap score 0.85 (candidate, not proof). SSRF reaches internal services and cloud metadata credentials.
findings.fix_hint: Allowlist destinations and block private and link-local ranges.

findings.title: Unbounded retry loop
findings.detail: Snap score 0.80 (candidate, not proof). A permanent failure turns into an infinite loop that burns resources and floods logs.

evidence.snippet: while True:

findings.fix_hint: Cap attempts and total elapsed time, then surface the error.

findings.title: No timeout on network calls
findings.detail: Snap score 0.78 (candidate, not proof). A hung dependency freezes the whole service.
findings.fix_hint: Pass an explicit timeout everywhere.

findings.title: [absence] Multi-step write without transaction
findings.detail: Snap score 0.75 (candidate, not proof). A crash between steps leaves orphan or half-applied records.
findings.fix_hint: Wrap writes in a transaction or use an outbox with idempotent consumers.

findings.title: Wall clock used for durations
findings.detail: Snap score 0.99 (candidate, not proof). NTP steps and DST changes make wall-clock differences negative or wrong.

evidence.snippet: while time.time() - start < seconds:

findings.fix_hint: Use time.monotonic() or performance.now() for intervals.

findings.title: [absence] No signal handler for shutdown
findings.detail: Snap score 0.99 (candidate, not proof). Abrupt kills during deploys drop in-flight work and corrupt partial state.
findings.fix_hint: Handle SIGTERM by stopping intake, draining in-flight work, then exiting.

findings.title: Cache stampede on miss
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). When a hot key expires, all callers hit the backend simultaneously.

evidence.snippet: hit = _cache.get('rates')

findings.fix_hint: Coalesce concurrent misses and refresh before expiry.

findings.title: Sensitive data stored or sent unencrypted
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Interception or disk access exposes the data.
findings.fix_hint: Use TLS and encrypt sensitive fields at rest.

findings.title: Mutable module-level global state
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Hidden global state makes behavior order-dependent and tests interfere with each other.

evidence.snippet: counts = {}

findings.fix_hint: Move the state into an object passed in explicitly.

findings.title: [absence] Login or reset lacks rate limiting
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Attackers can brute-force credentials and codes.

evidence.snippet: def login(user, password, api_key):

findings.fix_hint: Add per-account and per-IP throttling.

findings.title: [absence] Currency missing from monetary values
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Mixed currencies get summed or compared as if equal.

evidence.snippet: def order_total(items):

findings.fix_hint: Pair every amount with a currency code or use a Money type.

findings.title: UI or HTTP layer containing business logic
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Logic buried in handlers cannot be reused or tested without the web stack.

evidence.snippet: @app.post('/profile/update')

findings.fix_hint: Extract the logic into a service function the handler calls.

findings.title: Threads or tasks never joined
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Unobserved workers die silently and leak resources.

evidence.snippet: t.start()

findings.fix_hint: Keep handles, join or await them, and propagate their exceptions.

findings.title: Unbounded concurrency or thread creation per item
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Thousands of workers thrash the scheduler and exhaust memory or file handles.

evidence.snippet: ts = [threading.Thread(target=record, args=(e,)) for e in events]

findings.fix_hint: Use a bounded pool or semaphore.

findings.title: Sleep used for synchronization
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Fixed delays are flaky on slow systems and waste time on fast ones.

evidence.snippet: time.sleep(5)

findings.fix_hint: Wait on a readiness condition or event instead.

findings.title: Domain layer importing framework or I/O
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). The dependency direction is inverted and the core cannot be tested in isolation.

evidence.snippet: from flask import Flask, request, abort

findings.fix_hint: Define an interface in the core and implement it in an outer adapter.

findings.title: Logout does not invalidate token
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Stolen tokens stay usable after the user believes they signed out.
findings.fix_hint: Revoke server-side sessions and refresh tokens on logout and password change.

findings.title: Batch job aborts on first failure
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). One poison record blocks all others and repeats on every rerun.
findings.fix_hint: Catch per item, record failures to a dead-letter store, and continue.

findings.title: [absence] Synchronized scheduling stampede
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Aligned bursts overload shared dependencies, a thundering herd.

evidence.snippet: TTL = 60

findings.fix_hint: Add random jitter to schedules, TTLs, and reconnect delays.

findings.title: [absence] Batch job cannot resume
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Crashes in long jobs waste hours of work and can create duplicates.
findings.fix_hint: Persist a checkpoint or make each item idempotent and skip completed ones.

findings.title: Database call without timeout
findings.detail: Snap score 0.96 (candidate, not proof). A stalled database can pin every worker thread and cascade into a full outage.
findings.fix_hint: Configure connect and statement timeouts on the client.

findings.title: Unbounded cache growth
findings.detail: Snap score 0.96 (candidate, not proof). Unbounded caches are a slow memory leak that ends in OOM.
findings.fix_hint: Use an LRU or TTL cache with a maximum size.

findings.title: Subprocess without timeout or status check
findings.detail: Snap score 0.96 (candidate, not proof). A hung child blocks forever and failed commands are treated as success.
findings.fix_hint: Pass timeout and check=True, or test the return code.

findings.title: [absence] Missing health check endpoint
findings.detail: Snap score 0.95 (candidate, not proof). Orchestrators cannot detect hung instances or route traffic away from unready ones.
findings.fix_hint: Expose a health endpoint and configure liveness and readiness probes.

findings.title: Long-lived or non-expiring token
findings.detail: Snap score 0.95 (candidate, not proof). Stolen long-lived tokens give lasting access.
findings.fix_hint: Use short lifetimes plus refresh and revocation.

findings.title: [absence] State-changing request lacks CSRF protection
findings.detail: Snap score 0.95 (candidate, not proof). Attacker pages can trigger actions in the victim's session.
findings.fix_hint: Require CSRF tokens or SameSite cookies and do not exempt routes casually.

findings.title: Retry without backoff
findings.detail: Snap score 0.94 (candidate, not proof). Tight retries amplify load on an already failing dependency.
findings.fix_hint: Use exponential backoff with jitter and a capped delay.

findings.title: Flaky sleeps instead of waiting on a condition
findings.detail: Snap score 0.93 (candidate, not proof). Slow when generous, flaky when tight.

evidence.snippet: time.sleep(5)

findings.fix_hint: Wait on an event or poll with a deadline.

findings.title: [absence] Session not rotated on login
findings.detail: Snap score 0.91 (candidate, not proof). Session fixation lets an attacker pre-set a victim's session.
findings.fix_hint: Regenerate the session id on authentication and privilege change.

findings.title: Full user object sent to LLM or tracker
findings.detail: Snap score 0.91 (candidate, not proof). New fields added later silently leak to the third party.
findings.fix_hint: Build the payload from an explicit field allowlist.

findings.title: File opened without close
findings.detail: Snap score 0.88 (candidate, not proof). Leaked descriptors accumulate until the process hits its file limit.
findings.fix_hint: Use a with-block or try/finally to close the handle.

findings.title: Chatty interface: many small calls instead of one batch
findings.detail: Snap score 0.88 (candidate, not proof). Latency multiplies with call count.
findings.fix_hint: Offer a batch call or return the data together.

findings.title: Socket or connection not closed
findings.detail: Snap score 0.65 (candidate, not proof). Leaked connections exhaust server limits and ephemeral ports under load.
findings.fix_hint: Reuse a pooled client and close connections in finally or a context manager.

findings.title: Health check always returns OK
findings.detail: Snap score 0.75 (candidate, not proof). A health check that cannot fail gives false confidence and delays failover.
findings.fix_hint: Check critical dependencies and worker liveness in the handler.

findings.title: Leaky abstraction exposing storage details
findings.detail: Snap score 0.73 (candidate, not proof). Callers become coupled to the schema, so storage changes ripple everywhere.
findings.fix_hint: Return domain types and keep storage types inside the repository.

findings.title: [absence] Retrying non-idempotent operations
findings.detail: Snap score 0.51 (candidate, not proof). Retries after ambiguous failures duplicate charges, messages, or rows.
findings.fix_hint: Add an idempotency key or deduplicate on the receiving side.

findings.title: Admin action gated by client flag
findings.detail: Snap score 0.50 (candidate, not proof). Anyone can set the flag and gain admin power.
findings.fix_hint: Check role against server-side user records.

findings.title: [absence] Expensive endpoint without limits
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Unbounded input enables resource exhaustion.
findings.fix_hint: Enforce maximum sizes, page limits and timeouts.

findings.title: [absence] No circuit breaker on dependency
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Repeated calls to a dead dependency tie up threads and propagate the outage upstream.
findings.fix_hint: Wrap the dependency client in a circuit breaker with a fallback.

findings.title: [absence] Public function with undocumented contract
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Callers guess and guess wrong.

evidence.snippet: def save_state(path, state):

findings.fix_hint: Document the contract and add type hints.

findings.title: [absence] Failure path emits no metric
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Without failure metrics, alerts cannot fire and error rates are invisible.
findings.fix_hint: Add error counters labeled by failure type in each failure branch.

findings.title: Business constants as magic numbers
findings.detail: Snap score 0.95 (candidate, not proof). Readers cannot tell meaning, and changes require hunting every occurrence.
findings.fix_hint: Name the constant and define it once.

findings.title: Stringly-typed config or data passing
findings.detail: Snap score 0.95 (candidate, not proof). A key typo or schema change fails only at runtime.
findings.fix_hint: Define a dataclass or schema and parse once at the boundary.

findings.title: Rename without fsync
findings.detail: Snap score 0.95 (candidate, not proof). Power loss can leave the renamed file empty or stale despite a successful return.
findings.fix_hint: Call flush and os.fsync on the file (and directory) before relying on it.

findings.title: Dependency constructed inside the function
findings.detail: Snap score 0.89 (candidate, not proof). It prevents substitution in tests and hides coupling.
findings.fix_hint: Accept the dependency as a parameter.

findings.title: [absence] Migration without rollback
findings.detail: Snap score 0.58 (candidate, not proof). A bad release cannot be rolled back safely without a reversible migration.
findings.fix_hint: Write a downgrade step or document and take a backup before the irreversible change.

findings.title: Exception logged without traceback
findings.detail: Snap score 0.79 (candidate, not proof). Without the stack the failing line and call path are unknown.
findings.fix_hint: Use logger.exception or pass exc_info=True.

findings.title: Dead module never imported
findings.detail: Snap score 0.72 (candidate, not proof). Dead code is maintenance load and misleads readers about what the system does.
findings.fix_hint: Delete it; version control keeps history.

findings.title: Login reveals whether account exists
findings.detail: Snap score 0.53 (candidate, not proof). Account enumeration aids targeted attacks.
findings.fix_hint: Return one generic response for all cases.
